newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-UNWELL BAIA MAY MISS GERMANY QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UNWELL BAIA MAY MISS GERMANY QUALIFIER.

text.p: Portugal goalkeeper Vitor Baia has flu and could miss Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Germany.
Team doctor Bargao Santos told reporters the Barcelona keeper spent the afternoon in bed in his hotel room while his team mates held their last training session.
"Baia's condition is a worry to us," Santos said. "He's in bed with fever in his hotel. We'll do all we can to make him ready for the match, but for now I can't say whether he will recover in time."
Portugal, the only team to beat Germany in a World Cup qualifier, are desperate for history to repeat itself when they face the European champions in group nine.
The Portuguese, who beat Germany 1-0 away 11 years ago, lead the group with seven points, one more than Ukraine, who have a match in hand, and three ahead of Germany, who have two games in hand.
